design.job_spec_precondition: Before acquiring the runner lease, commit two exact job specifications that pin seed, map size, maximum decision steps, every in-game name, every image or policy identity, and candidate/parent seat mapping. Hash both files in this contract or a linked immutable addendum. The second job must change only the candidate/parent seat mapping. No episode may start before that commit is pushed.

definitions.decision_window: The first 20 non-spawn Odin decision records in each episode. Fewer than 20 records fails the screen.
definitions.conquest_action: An accepted selectedActionKind=attack targeting Terra Nullius or a non-K1Z rival.
definitions.proactive_social_action: A selected alliance_request, break_alliance, target_player, donate_gold, donate_troops, quick_chat, emoji, embargo, embargo_stop, or embargo_all action. Exclude a kp2 alliance_request only when the same decision offers a matching reciprocal alliance_reject.
definitions.d20_tiles: Use auditAfter.tilesOwned on decision 20. If absent, use auditBefore.tilesOwned on decision 21. If neither exists, the episode is unauditable and fails.
definitions.d50_tiles: Use auditAfter.tilesOwned on decision 50. If absent, use auditBefore.tilesOwned on decision 51. If neither exists, the episode is unauditable and fails.
definitions.placement_point: Per orientation: 1 when candidate final rank is lower than parent, 0.5 on equal rank, 0 when worse.
definitions.strong_rival_conversion: An os1-marked accepted attack on a bordered, attackable, non-K1Z rival whose decision-time relativeTroopRatio is at least 1.6.

pass_conditions.mechanism_reach: At least one os1 marker in each candidate orientation and at least one strong_rival_conversion across the pair.
pass_conditions.opening_conquest: At least 17 of the first 20 decisions are conquest_action in each candidate orientation.
pass_conditions.opening_social: At most one proactive_social_action in the first 20 decisions of each candidate orientation.
pass_conditions.decision_20_lift: Sum of candidate d20_tiles across both orientations is strictly greater than the parent sum.
pass_conditions.decision_50_noninferiority: Sum of candidate d50_tiles across both orientations is at least the parent sum.
pass_conditions.placement_lift: Candidate placement_point sum across two orientations is strictly greater than 1.0.
pass_conditions.safety: Across every candidate decision: zero unexplained holds, rejected decisions, fallback or planner degradation, unresolved harmful targets, and K1Z harm.

stop_rules: Any missing required field or unauditable episode fails the screen.
Any pass-condition failure closes OS1 without threshold tuning.
A marker, early territory lift, or one favorable orientation alone is not a pass.
No upload or league mutation follows a failed local screen.
